GAO Bid Protest Nexus

About
Five filters — Grounds plus disposition, overall outcome, procurement authority and protest posture — drive all three views. Map: click any node to see its connections and the decisions behind it. Table: B-number, short description and PDF links. Dynamic Search: full-text search over the decision corpus. Analysis: pick decisions anywhere in the dashboard, then summarize them one by one or compare them as a set.

Dynamic Search — full-text search across the 5,986 downloaded decisions. Returns the passages that match your wording, ranked, each linked to its source decision.

Ground detail

How often this ground is sustained, against the corpus base rate, with the 95% confidence interval that its sample size supports. Computed over all 5,986 decisions — the side-panel filters do not apply here. Most of the apparent spread between grounds is sampling noise: correct for testing all 33 and only OCI, Corrective Action Challenge and Technical Evaluation are distinguishable from the base rate.

Decision analysis

Key-element summaries of GAO bid protest decisions, written by an OpenAI-compatible model from the decision text. Pick decisions anywhere in the dashboard — the Map popups, the Table, or Dynamic Search results — then read them one at a time or compare the set. Output lands here, never in the view you picked from.
